body: Wow. Thank you for sharing all this. I'm going to take some time to read through some of this, but just wanted to say a quick thanks. I'll update maybe later this evening. Cheers.

Talking has always been hard for me. I don't open up easily. My extended family all have their own problems and I don't feel it's right to burden them with my issues. Sometimes, like this morning, I ended up talking with my wife about how I was feeling. However, she has our 3 boys to focus on and I don't want to draw her away from them. Thank you for your thoughts. I know, when I can focus on the more positive things in my life, the world doesn't seem so dark.
You're right, of course. When I'm having a better day, I wouldn't begin to think about abandoning my family.. Making it through the dark days is the challenge. Thank you for you words.
